name: VoxTicket RAG evaluation dataset v2
notes: Valid JSON (no comments) so the RagEvaluationHarnessManualTest ObjectMapper can read it. Each question carries type (required by the harness), category (the policy document filename stem used by KnowledgeIngestionService, or null for unsupported questions), language, and a one-sentence expected answer grounded in that document. Urdu and Roman Urdu questions are drafts: the user MUST review them for language correctness before the run (needs_review=true). Unsupported questions have no expected answer and no document; a correct system response retrieves nothing above the similarity threshold.
